# homarr_server_board_settings (Data Source)

Reads the instance-wide board defaults under *Management > Settings > Board* without taking ownership of them, as the `homarr_server_board_settings` resource would. Requires an admin API key.

Homarr reports the home boards as stored and does not check them on the way out: after onboarding both point at Homarr's private onboarding board, and a board deleted since keeps its id here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires an admin API key.
data "homarr_server_board_settings" "this" {}

resource "random_password" "alice" {
  length           = 32
  override_special = "!()-_=+"
}

# Pin alice to the instance's default home board, following it on every apply,
# without taking over the instance-wide settings. This overrides any home board
# of her groups; leave home_board_id out to get Homarr's own fallback instead,
# which tries those before the instance default. A board deleted since keeps its
# id in the settings, and the apply then fails on it.
resource "homarr_user" "alice" {
  username      = "alice"
  password      = random_password.alice.result
  home_board_id = data.homarr_server_board_settings.this.home_board_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enable_status_by_default` (Boolean) Whether newly added board items show their online status by default.
- `force_disable_status` (Boolean) Whether online-status pings are disabled across every board.
- `home_board_id` (String) Board shown on desktop to anonymous visitors and to users with no personal or group home board, or null when none is set.
- `mobile_home_board_id` (String) Board shown on mobile to anonymous visitors and to users with no personal or group home board, or null when none is set, in which case mobile falls back to `home_board_id`.
